title.en: The Diesel Page That Prints 30 m³/h Is Diesel 50, Not Diesel 30
title.zh: 印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 30 m³/h on Diesel 50, with 6105 / 99 kW. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Order the page that holds the output cell you mean.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 30 m³/h 印在柴油50上，发动机 6105 / 99 kW。柴油30印 15 m³/h。订那张装着你要的输送量格的页面。

h1.en: Ask for 30 m³/h on the Diesel 50 Path
h1.zh: 在柴油50的路径上询问 30 m³/h

directAnswer.en: If the output cell you want is 30 m³/h on a diesel trailer, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints it on Diesel 50: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 450 m, Kawasaki 140, 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm and 3300 kg. The page description attaches 1 cm aggregate to that distance pair and does not add a separate maximum-aggregate specification row. Diesel 30’s output is 15 m³/h. Send your stone size with [/en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/](/en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/) to the contact page. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 如果你要的柴油拖泵输送量格是 30 m³/h，河北品锦机械（邢台）把它印在柴油50上：6105 / 99 kW、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 450 m、川崎 140、4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm、3300 kg。页面说明把 1 cm 骨料标在这组距离上，没有另加最大骨料规格行。柴油30的输送量是 15 m³/h。把石子粒径和 [/zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/) 发到询盘页。没有印价格。

body.en: Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h on a 55 kW motor. The shared numeral 50 does not share the 30 m³/h cell.
body.zh: 电动50在 55 kW 电机上印 26 m³/h。共同的数字 50 并不共享 30 m³/h 这一格。

body.en: The inquiry should say 6105 / 99 kW so it cannot be read as Diesel 60’s 144 kW 6105.
body.zh: 询盘应写 6105 / 99 kW，这样才不会被读成柴油60的 144 kW 6105。

body.en: 3300 kg. Electric 60 is also 3300 kg and is an electric page. Send the diesel path.
body.zh: 3300 kg。电动60也是 3300 kg，但是电动页。请发送柴油路径。

answer.en: The sheet prints 15 m³/h. The name is not the output.
answer.zh: 该页印 15 m³/h。名称不是输送量。

answer.en: Not on the Diesel 30 list used here. Diesel 50 prints it.
answer.zh: 此处使用的柴油30列表上没有。柴油50印了。

question.en: Is the price  printed beside 30 m³/h?

alt.en: Diesel 50 concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 柴油50型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
